Transformation Log.Rule: Regroup source lines by vendor in batches of up to three; assign normalized line numbers 10/20/30.
Transformation Log.Notes: Original PO and line values remain on PO Lines and in Source Crosswalk.

Transformation Log.Rule: Add four POs and ten PO Lines with fresh updates, stable ETAs, valid status, and zero exceptions.
Transformation Log.Notes: All records are labeled Generated Happy Path.

Transformation Log.Rule: Materialize one Exception for each source Issue Flag = Y and retain every Exception Queue record.
Transformation Log.Notes: Every generated exception keeps the exact source exception type.

Transformation Log.Rule: Retain valid same-vendor links; remap missing or vendor-mismatched source links to the least-loaded shipment for the same vendor.
Transformation Log.AffectedRecords: {"Missing source shipment reassigned":32,"Vendor-mismatched source shipment reassigned":18,"Retained valid source link":5,"Happy-path shipment assigned":4}
Transformation Log.Notes: Original Container ID remains in SourceContainerID.

Transformation Log.Rule: Create Decisions for the union of source Decision Required flags and exceptions having alternatives.
Retain a single source recommendation; otherwise select the feasible option with highest Margin Protected minus Incremental Cost.
Transformation Log.AffectedRecords: 7 multiple-source and 3 missing-source recommendation groups normalized
Transformation Log.Notes: Source recommendation, owner, and status remain on Decision Alternatives.

Transformation Log.Rule: Store only current milestone state on PO Line and create Milestone Owners bridge records.
Calculate elapsed days and staleness against App Config DEMO_AS_OF_DATE.
Transformation Log.Notes: Prevents demo results from changing with TODAY().

Transformation Log.Rule: Extract row-level cost, revenue, margin, and cash assumptions embedded in original formulas into explicit Plan Line fields.
Transformation Log.Notes: Maintains all original planning calculations without hidden constants.

Transformation Log.Rule: Do not transform Mobile Actions, Notifications, or Vendor Scorecard records.
Transformation Log.Notes: Their fields remain documented in Field Map as Deferred.
